theory.intro: A transversal makes angle pairs whose names come from where they sit. The lines do not need to be parallel for the pairs to have these names.

development.solution_text: None of these; they do not occupy matching corners and both are exterior.

development.question_text:
[tikz]
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=0.62]\draw (-2.4,1.1)--(2.4,1.1);\draw (-2.4,-1.55)--(2.4,-0.35);\draw (-1.2,-2.2)--(1.2,2.2);\node at (1.0,0.75) {$4$};\node at (-0.1,-1.5) {$8$};\end{tikzpicture}
[/tikz]
The crossed lines are not parallel. Identify the relationship between angles $4$ and $8$.

mastery.question_text: A pair lies between the crossed lines. What single positional check distinguishes alternate from co-interior angles?
mastery.solution_text: Alternate angles are on opposite sides of the transversal; co-interior angles are on the same side.
